summary_en: True Data will acquire 100% of Cosmo Net, operator of MUSASI, a sales management system for professional shops handling construction materials and tools. The acquisition will integrate professional market transaction data with True Data's consumer purchasing data, enabling the company to replicate its 'Data × AI Insight' business model in the professional sector.
title_en: Supplementary Explanation Materials Regarding Complete Subsidiary Acquisition of Cosmo Net Inc.
translation_en_brief:
True Data announced its first M&A transaction, acquiring 100% equity of Cosmo Net Inc., a company operating MUSASI, a sales management and point-of-sale system serving professional shops that handle construction materials, hardware, tools, and housing-related products. Cosmo Net, which launched MUSASI in 1992, serves approximately 180 trading partners and maintains a product master database of roughly 400,000 items. True Data intends to execute the stock acquisition on October 13, 2026.

The core strategic objective is to acquire a data infrastructure for the professional market. True Data has built a proven business model by standardizing retail transaction data from its 6.5 million annual active users and converting it into AI-driven insights for retailers and manufacturers, achieving an 81.4% customer retention rate and 201 manufacturers using its services. By acquiring Cosmo Net's transaction data spanning professional shop sales, pricing by customer, billing, procurement, and inventory management, True Data plans to replicate this 'Data × AI Insight' operating model in the professional sector.

The company envisions expanding downstream applications including demand forecasting and inventory optimization for professional shops, and subsequently providing data insights to building materials, hardware, and tool manufacturers. The acquisition creates a foundation for connecting consumer and professional market data and establishing a scalable template of the 'Data × AI Insight' model for expansion into other industries.
